variants.briefing:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near [Location]. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.  

Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

variants.briefing:
As a consequence of the ongoing radiation storm on Pyro I, some of the invasive kopions have become irradiated. This poses a threat to the health of the indigenous wildlife and to those who live and work in [Location]. 

We are seeking out a skilled contractor who can cull any irradiated kopions in and around [Location]. Do not accept this contract unless you have the proper weapons and equipment that can reliably function in a radioactive environment. 

Your compensation will be adjusted to match the risks associated with this contract.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

variants.briefing:
We’ve recently received reports from our team in [Location], that a particularly virile pack of kopions are causing a surge in numbers. As a result, their prey is being over hunted, and if left unattended, will ultimately lead to the starvation of the kopion population there.

We are looking for a skilled contractor to cull this pack of kopions in a swift and efficient manner, assisting with bringing a natural equilibrium back to [Location]. Access to combat equipment, transport, and a familiarity with wild and unpredictable animals are all required for this job.

For further details on the targeted creatures, please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
